remarks: This beautiful townhouse with an elevator at Richmond Mews offers an easy, low-maintenance lifestyle just a short walk from town, with views of Mead Park and thoughtful design throughout. Inside, 9+ foot ceilings and oversized windows make the home feel bright and open, with hardwood floors throughout. The double-height entry welcomes you right in. The floor plan is very flexible, allowing for a formal dining room, family room, and living room depending on your needs. The gourmet kitchen has a large center island with French doors opening to a private patio. The spacious primary suite offers bedroom views of the park paired with a large sitting room or office, plus 2 walk-in closets and ensuite bath. Two additional bedrooms and a full bath complete the upper level. The finished lower level adds valuable, versatile square footage - ideal as a home gym, playroom, or additional office space. There is ample storage throughout and an attached 2-car garage. The cedar roof was replaced in 2025. Located close to New Canaan's shops, restaurants, and train station, 30 Richmond Hill Road offers a convenient, well-designed home in a sought-after location.
